activeAbilities.name: Deadly Blossom
activeAbilities.description: Fires a specially enhanced projectile with Hansel and Gretel, dealing Pyro damage to enemies in the path and inflicting Laceration on them.

activeAbilities.name: Gunpowder Revelry
activeAbilities.description: Switches the ranged weapon to Hansel and Gretel. In this state, Lynn can shoot and use skills but cannot move. Shooting deals damage to all enemies in front. During shooting, gains 1 stack that increases Lynn's ATK speed every 0.2s, up to 35 stacks. Using Hansel and Gretel continuously consumes Sanity, during which Lynn is immune to Hitstun when taking damage. When Sanity reaches 0 or the skill is used again, withdraws Hansel and Gretel.

passiveAbilities.name: Tactical Rapid Fire
passiveAbilities.description: When not firing, gains 1 stack of Preload per second, up to 6 stacks. When firing, consumes all Preload stacks to gain Suppressing Fire for a period of time. Suppressing Fire: Increases the damage based on the number of the consumed Preload stacks. Cannot gain preload stack during Suppressing Fire.

passiveAbilities.name: The Unforgivable
passiveAbilities.description: Immediately removes Laceration and deals damage once the Lacerated Wound count reaches its maximum.

intron.description: Gains 6 stacks of Preloaded upon entering combat, and increases Morale by 38% for 45s.
During Gunpowder Revelry, reduces damage taken by 20%, and decreases the interval of gaining the ATK speed boost to 0.06s.
Deadly Blossom Level +2; Tactical Rapid Fire Level +1.
Increases damage dealt to targets with a HP percentage lower than 40% by 38%.
Gunpowder Revelry Level +2; Tactical Rapid Fire Level +1.
During Gunpowder Revelry, when triggering bonus effect using Hansel and Gretel, inflicts Laceration on the target(s) for 8s.

activeAbilities.name: Chrysalis Dreamscape
activeAbilities.description: Creates 1 Phantasm and then flashes forward. This skill can be used at any time without interrupting Psyche's current action. In Flamboyance state, this skill is replaced with Phototaxis.

activeAbilities.name: Fluorescent Eclosion
activeAbilities.description: Enters Flamboyance state and gains the ability to fly. When in Flamboyance state, Psyche can only use skills and shoot, and the skill Chrysalis Dreamscape is replaced with Phototaxis.

passiveAbilities.name: Amberlight
passiveAbilities.description: When dealing CRIT DMG, gains one of the following buffs at random: ATK increase, skill damage increase, or berserker increase. Increases damage dealt for each buff Psyche gains, up to 12 buffs.
